d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how, starting November 30, the Democratic Republic of Congo—the source of roughly three-quarters of the world’s cobalt—is indefinitely suspending all cobalt exports. Announced by strategic minerals regulator ARECOMS, the sweeping ban halts shipments from both massive industrial mines and small-scale artisanal operations. Facing weak battery demand, swollen global inventories, and steadily falling prices, Kinshasa is pulling the plug for the second time in under two years to force a market reset and overhaul its export quota system.
